packageRules.description: One PR for everything that is not a major bump. Majors stay on their own, and a security update still opens its own PR regardless of this rule.

The pinned Bun version and its five per-asset SHA-256 digests (build.gradle.kts) are one physical upgrade, never six independent ones — group them together at every update type, including majors, so they always land in a single PR.

customManagers.description: Bump the pinned Bun release tag in build.gradle.kts.

Bump each pinned per-asset Bun archive SHA-256 in build.gradle.kts's bunDigests map. Each digest line is paired with its own `// renovate: currentValue=` marker comment (see build.gradle.kts) because this datasource needs the version the digest was pinned under alongside the digest itself, in the same match.
